title: Use a default value
summary: Bash: Use a default value. Set name to Asha.
introduction: ${name:-Guest} uses Guest when name is unset or empty. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Use a default value with Bash

blocks.text: Use a terminal with Bash. Save each example as lesson.sh and run bash lesson.sh. These practice scripts do not delete or change files.
The variable is empty. The :- form therefore supplies Guest.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The colon makes an empty value use the fallback too.
